mockup:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high fidelity desktop browser collectible card cultivation GAME UI design, wide 16:10 landscape, front-facing flat digital screen, no device mockup.
Create a polished original Chinese fantasy creature card collection game called "星序" with small subtitle "ASTERIA". Reference the level of polish and navigation hierarchy of major premium Asian games' character archive screens, and the clarity of Pokemon TCG Pocket collection grids, but use entirely ORIGINAL creatures and visual identity, no copyrighted characters or logos.
Visual thesis: warm ivory archive paper, midnight ink navigation, fine champagne-gold ornament, painterly celestial creature illustrations, calm sophisticated game interface, not a SaaS dashboard.
Canvas layout: full height narrow 176px midnight/navy sidebar left with a gold four-point constellation insignia, brand 星序 / ASTERIA, vertically spaced navigation labels 星灵图鉴 (active gold highlight), 共鸣培育, 观星召唤, 兑换工坊, 培育手记. Bottom profile explorer icon and 本地原型.
Warm ivory main canvas. At top a slim header with breadcrumb 收藏 / 星灵图鉴 on left and three currency counters on right, gold coin 1,280, pale crystal 360, summoning tickets 3. Main content occupies middle 70 percent, right inspector occupies about 24 percent with a subtle vertical divider.
Main heading 星灵图鉴, small uppercase COMPANION ARCHIVE eyebrow, subtitle 已收集 8 / 12. Under it understated filter tabs 全部星灵 / 辉光 / 月影 / 森息 and a compact search icon field.
Middle workspace has a clean 4-column by 2-row collection of 8 collectible portrait cards, substantial full-art illustrations, subtle thin beveled frames, each with small rarity SSR or SR or R in corner, tiny affinity mark, elegant Chinese name in white at bottom over vignette, small owned count below. Cards should be true richly illustrated game cards, not flat generic icon boxes.
Eight images: luminous white blue moon-antler deer, amber fire-winged fox, gentle moss-covered rabbit forest guardian, smaller blue moon deer, ember fox pup, forest rabbit with flowers, aurora deer, golden fox. A selected moon deer card has a thin champagne gold border and small selected tick. Names 月纱灵鹿 / 烛羽灵狐 / 苔冠旅者 / 银角初醒 / 晨光使者 / 林间回响 / 星河守望 / 金焰巡游.
Right inspector: text 星灵档案 and No. 001; one large beautiful portrait artwork of white moon deer with crystalline antlers, dark midnight cyan forest, gold rarity SSR. Below name 月纱灵鹿, small tags 月影 / 首尾呼应, 3 simple star breakthrough indicators, description 首尾为同相时，共鸣额外 +12。 A slim rank progress divider and paired actions 同卡强化 / 分解. Very bottom large dark ink button 加入培育阵容.
Bottom of center workspace a restrained horizontal preparation strip with title 培育阵容, 3 small selected creature portrait circles and empty slots (6 total) and text 选择 6 张星灵，发现你的共鸣组合, and a gold primary button 开始共鸣培育 with arrow.
Typography: sharp readable Chinese sans serif body, restrained elegant serif Chinese page heading, editorial hierarchy, generous spacing, precise alignment, professional production game UI. Gold accent only in chrome, with jewel colors only in artwork.
Avoid: wireframe appearance, piles of dashboard stat boxes, glass neon blue SaaS style, oversaturated rainbow UI, excessive ornamental flourishes, phone frame, marketing landing page, browser chrome, all caps block text, existing game IP. Render Chinese labels carefully.
